cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, narrative-driven atmosphere, characterized by intimacy and restraint.
cards.palette: A solo cello provides the initial melodic and harmonic anchor, playing long, mournful lines from the Intro through the first half.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the roots of the ancient pine,
Where shadows stretch and the mosses twine,
The stones hold secrets of a thousand years,
Whispered in echoes and forgotten fears.
[Pre-Chorus]
The mountains bow their heavy heads,
Where the river of time forever treads.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the gray,
Where the golden sun begins to fray,
A kingdom carved in granite and bone,
Upon a throne of weathered stone.
[Verse]
The forest breathes a heavy sigh,
Under the watch of a charcoal sky,
Every leaf is a story told,
In shades of emerald and autumn gold.
[Pre-Chorus]
The mountains bow their heavy heads,
Where the river of time forever treads.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the gray,
Where the golden sun begins to fray,
A kingdom carved in granite and bone,
Upon a throne of weathered stone.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The valley wakes in a sudden light,
Chasing the ghosts of the coming night.
[Chorus]
Mountains rise to touch the gray,
Where the golden sun begins to fray,
A kingdom carved in granite and bone,
Upon a throne of weathered stone.
[Outro]
